query: On L1, create a prefix-list permitting exactly 10.100.1.0/24, wrap it in a route-map, and apply it outbound to both spine neighbours. Advertisements must be unchanged afterwards.
reference_playbook:
---
- name: Agentic-SONiC bench_net dataset item - BGP-M-04
  hosts: sonic_switches
  gather_facts: false
  become: true
  become_method: sudo
  tasks:

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # PRE-CHECKS
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    - name: Verify L1 (SONiC-VS-1) is running AS 65001
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp summary"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_bgp_precheck
      failed_when: >-
        l1_bgp_precheck.rc != 0
        or 'local AS number 65001' not in l1_bgp_precheck.stdout
      changed_when: false

    - name: Verify L1-S1 BGP session is Established before change
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.1.1.1" | grep -i "BGP state"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_s1_state_precheck
      failed_when: >-
        l1_s1_state_precheck.rc != 0
        or 'established' not in l1_s1_state_precheck.stdout | lower
      changed_when: false

    - name: Verify L1-S2 BGP session is Established before change
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.1.2.1" | grep -i "BGP state"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_s2_state_precheck
      failed_when: >-
        l1_s2_state_precheck.rc != 0
        or 'established' not in l1_s2_state_precheck.stdout | lower
      changed_when: false

    - name: Verify S2-L2 BGP session is Established before change
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.2.2.0" | grep -i "BGP state"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-6"
      register: s2_l2_state_precheck
      failed_when: >-
        s2_l2_state_precheck.rc != 0
        or 'established' not in s2_l2_state_precheck.stdout | lower
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Capture pre-change BGP uptime for the three sessions.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    - name: Capture pre-change L1-S1 uptime
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp summary" | awk '$1=="10.1.1.1" {print $9}'
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_s1_uptime_pre
      failed_when: l1_s1_uptime_pre.rc != 0 or l1_s1_uptime_pre.stdout | trim == ''
      changed_when: false

    - name: Capture pre-change L1-S2 uptime
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp summary" | awk '$1=="10.1.2.1" {print $9}'
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_s2_uptime_pre
      failed_when: l1_s2_uptime_pre.rc != 0 or l1_s2_uptime_pre.stdout | trim == ''
      changed_when: false

    - name: Capture pre-change S2-L2 uptime
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp summary" | awk '$1=="10.2.2.0" {print $9}'
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-6"
      register: s2_l2_uptime_pre
      failed_when: s2_l2_uptime_pre.rc != 0 or s2_l2_uptime_pre.stdout | trim == ''
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Capture current advertised-prefix counts.
    # These are used to verify advertisements are unchanged afterwards.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    - name: Capture pre-change advertisement count to S1
      raw: >-
        sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.1.1.1 advertised-routes"
        | awk '/Total number of prefixes/ {print $5}' | tr -d ','
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_adv_s1_count_pre
      failed_when: l1_adv_s1_count_pre.rc != 0 or l1_adv_s1_count_pre.stdout | trim == ''
      changed_when: false

    - name: Capture pre-change advertisement count to S2
      raw: >-
        sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.1.2.1 advertised-routes"
        | awk '/Total number of prefixes/ {print $5}' | tr -d ','
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_adv_s2_count_pre
      failed_when: l1_adv_s2_count_pre.rc != 0 or l1_adv_s2_count_pre.stdout | trim == ''
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # REAL CHANGE 1:
    # Create/update exact prefix-list entry.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    - name: Configure PL-EXPORT on L1
      raw: >-
        sudo vtysh -c "configure terminal"
        -c "ip prefix-list PL-EXPORT seq 10 permit 10.100.1.0/24"
        -c "exit"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      ignore_errors: true

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # VERIFY immediately after real change 1.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    - name: Verify PL-EXPORT on L1
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show running-config"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_pl_verify
      failed_when: >-
        l1_pl_verify.rc != 0
        or 'ip prefix-list PL-EXPORT seq 10 permit 10.100.1.0/24' not in l1_pl_verify.stdout
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # REAL CHANGE 2:
    # Create/update route-map.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    - name: Configure RM-EXPORT on L1
      raw: >-
        sudo vtysh -c "configure terminal"
        -c "route-map RM-EXPORT permit 10"
        -c "match ip address prefix-list PL-EXPORT"
        -c "exit"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      ignore_errors: true

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # VERIFY immediately after real change 2.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    - name: Verify RM-EXPORT on L1
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show running-config"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_rm_verify
      failed_when: >-
        l1_rm_verify.rc != 0
        or 'route-map RM-EXPORT permit 10' not in l1_rm_verify.stdout
        or 'match ip address prefix-list PL-EXPORT' not in l1_rm_verify.stdout
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # REAL CHANGE 3:
    # Apply RM-EXPORT outbound to S1.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    - name: Apply RM-EXPORT outbound to S1
      raw: >-
        sudo vtysh -c "configure terminal"
        -c "router bgp 65001"
        -c "address-family ipv4 unicast"
        -c "neighbor 10.1.1.1 route-map RM-EXPORT out"
        -c "exit-address-family"
        -c "exit"
        -c "write memory"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      ignore_errors: true

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # VERIFY immediately after real change 3.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    - name: Verify RM-EXPORT is applied outbound to S1
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show running-config"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_s1_policy_verify
      failed_when: >-
        l1_s1_policy_verify.rc != 0
        or 'neighbor 10.1.1.1 route-map RM-EXPORT out' not in l1_s1_policy_verify.stdout
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # REAL CHANGE 4:
    # Apply RM-EXPORT outbound to S2.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    - name: Apply RM-EXPORT outbound to S2
      raw: >-
        sudo vtysh -c "configure terminal"
        -c "router bgp 65001"
        -c "address-family ipv4 unicast"
        -c "neighbor 10.1.2.1 route-map RM-EXPORT out"
        -c "exit-address-family"
        -c "exit"
        -c "write memory"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      ignore_errors: true

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # VERIFY immediately after real change 4.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    - name: Verify RM-EXPORT is applied outbound to S2
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show running-config"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_s2_policy_verify
      failed_when: >-
        l1_s2_policy_verify.rc != 0
        or 'neighbor 10.1.2.1 route-map RM-EXPORT out' not in l1_s2_policy_verify.stdout
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # VERIFY final L1 advertisements are unchanged.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    - name: Verify L1 still advertises 10.100.1.0/24 to S1
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.1.1.1 advertised-routes"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_adv_s1_after
      until: >-
        l1_adv_s1_after.rc == 0
        and '10.100.1.0/24' in l1_adv_s1_after.stdout
      retries: 6
      delay: 2
      failed_when: >-
        l1_adv_s1_after.rc != 0
        or '10.100.1.0/24' not in l1_adv_s1_after.stdout
      changed_when: false

    - name: Verify L1 still advertises 10.100.1.0/24 to S2
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.1.2.1 advertised-routes"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_adv_s2_after
      until: >-
        l1_adv_s2_after.rc == 0
        and '10.100.1.0/24' in l1_adv_s2_after.stdout
      retries: 6
      delay: 2
      failed_when: >-
        l1_adv_s2_after.rc != 0
        or '10.100.1.0/24' not in l1_adv_s2_after.stdout
      changed_when: false

    - name: Capture post-change advertisement count to S1
      raw: >-
        sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.1.1.1 advertised-routes"
        | awk '/Total number of prefixes/ {print $5}' | tr -d ','
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_adv_s1_count_post
      failed_when: l1_adv_s1_count_post.rc != 0 or l1_adv_s1_count_post.stdout | trim == ''
      changed_when: false

    - name: Capture post-change advertisement count to S2
      raw: >-
        sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.1.2.1 advertised-routes"
        | awk '/Total number of prefixes/ {print $5}' | tr -d ','
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_adv_s2_count_post
      failed_when: l1_adv_s2_count_post.rc != 0 or l1_adv_s2_count_post.stdout | trim == ''
      changed_when: false

    - name: Verify advertisement count to S1 is unchanged
      assert:
        that:
          - (l1_adv_s1_count_pre.stdout | trim | int) == (l1_adv_s1_count_post.stdout | trim | int)
        fail_msg: >-
          Advertisement count to S1 changed from
          {{ l1_adv_s1_count_pre.stdout | trim }}
          to
          {{ l1_adv_s1_count_post.stdout | trim }}
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"

    - name: Verify advertisement count to S2 is unchanged
      assert:
        that:
          - (l1_adv_s2_count_pre.stdout | trim | int) == (l1_adv_s2_count_post.stdout | trim | int)
        fail_msg: >-
          Advertisement count to S2 changed from
          {{ l1_adv_s2_count_pre.stdout | trim }}
          to
          {{ l1_adv_s2_count_post.stdout | trim }}
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # VERIFY S1 and S2 still receive the prefix.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    - name: Verify S1 still receives 10.100.1.0/24 from L1
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp 10.100.1.0/24"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-5"
      register: s1_route_verify
      until: >-
        s1_route_verify.rc == 0
        and '10.100.1.0/24' in s1_route_verify.stdout
      retries: 6
      delay: 2
      failed_when: >-
        s1_route_verify.rc != 0
        or '10.100.1.0/24' not in s1_route_verify.stdout
        or '65001' not in s1_route_verify.stdout
      changed_when: false

    - name: Verify S2 still receives 10.100.1.0/24 from L1
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp 10.100.1.0/24"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-6"
      register: s2_route_verify
      until: >-
        s2_route_verify.rc == 0
        and '10.100.1.0/24' in s2_route_verify.stdout
      retries: 6
      delay: 2
      failed_when: >-
        s2_route_verify.rc != 0
        or '10.100.1.0/24' not in s2_route_verify.stdout
        or '65001' not in s2_route_verify.stdout
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # VERIFY the three sessions remain Established.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    - name: Verify L1-S1 session remains Established
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.1.1.1" | grep -i "BGP state"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_s1_state_postcheck
      failed_when: >-
        l1_s1_state_postcheck.rc != 0
        or 'established' not in l1_s1_state_postcheck.stdout | lower
      changed_when: false

    - name: Verify L1-S2 session remains Established
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.1.2.1" | grep -i "BGP state"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_s2_state_postcheck
      failed_when: >-
        l1_s2_state_postcheck.rc != 0
        or 'established' not in l1_s2_state_postcheck.stdout | lower
      changed_when: false

    - name: Verify S2-L2 session remains Established
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.2.2.0" | grep -i "BGP state"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-6"
      register: s2_l2_state_postcheck
      failed_when: >-
        s2_l2_state_postcheck.rc != 0
        or 'established' not in s2_l2_state_postcheck.stdout | lower
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Capture post-change uptimes and verify continuous uptime.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    - name: Capture post-change L1-S1 uptime
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp summary" | awk '$1=="10.1.1.1" {print $9}'
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_s1_uptime_post
      failed_when: l1_s1_uptime_post.rc != 0 or l1_s1_uptime_post.stdout | trim == ''
      changed_when: false

    - name: Capture post-change L1-S2 uptime
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp summary" | awk '$1=="10.1.2.1" {print $9}'
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_s2_uptime_post
      failed_when: l1_s2_uptime_post.rc != 0 or l1_s2_uptime_post.stdout | trim == ''
      changed_when: false

    - name: Capture post-change S2-L2 uptime
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp summary" | awk '$1=="10.2.2.0" {print $9}'
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-6"
      register: s2_l2_uptime_post
      failed_when: s2_l2_uptime_post.rc != 0 or s2_l2_uptime_post.stdout | trim == ''
      changed_when: false

    - name: Verify L1-S1 uptime did not reset
      assert:
        that:
          - (l1_s1_uptime_pre.stdout | trim) == (l1_s1_uptime_post.stdout | trim)
        fail_msg: >-
          L1-S1 uptime changed from
          {{ l1_s1_uptime_pre.stdout | trim }}
          to
          {{ l1_s1_uptime_post.stdout | trim }}
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"

    - name: Verify L1-S2 uptime did not reset
      assert:
        that:
          - (l1_s2_uptime_pre.stdout | trim) == (l1_s2_uptime_post.stdout | trim)
        fail_msg: >-
          L1-S2 uptime changed from
          {{ l1_s2_uptime_pre.stdout | trim }}
          to
          {{ l1_s2_uptime_post.stdout | trim }}
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"

    - name: Verify S2-L2 uptime did not reset
      assert:
        that:
          - (s2_l2_uptime_pre.stdout | trim) == (s2_l2_uptime_post.stdout | trim)
        fail_msg: >-
          S2-L2 uptime changed from
          {{ s2_l2_uptime_pre.stdout | trim }}
          to
          {{ s2_l2_uptime_post.stdout | trim }}
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-6"

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Final display
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    - name: Display final S1 advertisement
      debug:
        var: l1_adv_s1_after.stdout_lines
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"

    - name: Display final S2 advertisement
      debug:
        var: l1_adv_s2_after.stdout_lines
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"

    - name: Display final S1 route
      debug:
        var: s1_route_verify.stdout_lines
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-5"

    - name: Display final S2 route
      debug:
        var: s2_route_verify.stdout_lines
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-6"
